title: Server-side admin gate missing on sibling admin resources (config PUT, keys DELETE)
description: Security-review observation during b7z9.40(a) (explicitly pre-existing, not introduced by it): the R-11-030 admin gate was wired into /diag/raw/* resources; sibling resources whose pinned rule table already demands ADMIN for mutations remain ungated server-side — ConfigResource.render_put (PUT /config) and KeyStoreResource.render_delete (DELETE /keys[/...]). Same fix shape as b7z9.40(a): injected AccessLevel resolver + denied_response helper from resources/base.py (can_access table + fail-closed default), with deny tests. Keeps every admin mutation behind the same server-side gate.
